title: RudderStack Destination Delivery Latency p95
app: RudderStack delivery and failed-events metrics via the RudderStack API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=rudderstack:delivery status="delivered"
| eval dur_s=round(latency_ms/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by destination_name
| where p95_s>30
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile delivery latency for each destination in RudderStack and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking RudderStack destinations by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest RudderStack timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest destinations with their owners.
visualization: Table of destination by p95 delivery latency, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in RudderStack so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
